# R4Realty - Noida Property Consultancy

R4Realty is a premium real estate advisory portal for property investments in Noida, Greater Noida, and Goa, led by Rajveer Singh. 
Govt. of India MSME / Udyam Registration: UDYAM-RJ-11-0089088.

This file serves as a guide for AI agents and LLMs to understand the site's structure, available properties, and investment guides.

## Main Navigation

- [Home](https://r4realty.in/) - Main landing page with contact forms and location mapping.
- [All Projects](https://r4realty.in/projects) - Catalog of residential, commercial, and plot projects.
- [Noida Projects](https://r4realty.in/projects/noida) - Verified Noida & Noida Expressway properties.
- [Greater Noida Projects](https://r4realty.in/projects/greater-noida) - Verified Greater Noida & Pari Chowk properties.

- [Blog & Guides](https://r4realty.in/blog) - Authoritative real estate guides and market reports.

## Focus Market — Greater Noida Freehold Corridors
High-appreciation RERA-approved land parcels within expanding industrial, educational, and logistics hubs along the Eastern Peripheral and Yamuna Expressways, delivering attractive capital gains and strong rental yields.
